chunks.arabic_text: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ الصَّفَّارُ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ بَشَّارٍ عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ عَنِ الْعَبَّاسِ الْوَرَّاقِ عَنْ رَجُلٍ سَمَّاهُ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ قَالَ
«إِذَا غَزَا قَوْمٌ بِغَيْرِ إِذْنِ الْإِمَامِ فَغَنِمُوا كَانَتِ الْغَنِيمَةُ كُلُّهَا لِلْإِمَامِ وَ إِذَا غَزَوْا بِأَمْرِ الْإِمَامِ فَغَنِمُوا كَانَ الْخُمُسُ لِلْإِمَامِ».

key_terms_keys: الغنيمةy acquired in battle, here referring to the total property taken by the soldiers or tribe in an unauthorized raid where the Imam claims full ownership before distribution to the fighters or treasury depending on interpretation, but here specified as entirely for the Imam initially or in a specific context of authority. In this specific text, it implies the whole booty is attributed to the Imam's domain/authority, often interpreted as the Imam taking the khums or the whole depending on the school's reading of 'for the Imam'. However, the text contrasts 'all for Imam' vs 'khums for Imam'. Standard Shia interpretation: Unauthorized = Imam takes all (or khums is deducted from all, but text says 'all is for Imam'). Authorized = Imam takes khums, rest to fighters. The text literally says 'the spoils entirely for the Imam' vs 'the khums for the Imam'. This usually implies the Imam's share is the whole in the first case, or the authority over the whole is his. In many fiqh contexts, 'for the Imam' in unauthorized means the Imam takes the khums and the rest is distributed, OR the Imam takes the whole. Let's stick to the literal: 'The spoils entirely for the Imam' vs 'The khums for the Imam'. This suggests a distinction in the Imam's portion or authority. Actually, a common interpretation is that in unauthorized raids, the Imam takes the khums (one fifth) and the rest is for the fighters, BUT some narrations say the Imam takes the whole. Let's look at the contrast: 'All for Imam' vs 'Khums for Imam'. This implies in the second case, only 1/5 goes to the Imam, and in the first, the whole goes to the Imam (or the Imam's authority covers the whole). Given the glossary term 'khums', I will use it. The key term is 'الْغَنِيمَةُ' and 'الْخُمُسُ'. I will add 'الْإِذْنُ' and 'الْأَمْرُ'. Let's refine key terms to be more precise. 'الْغَنِيمَةُ' (Spoils), 'الْخُمُسُ' (One-fifth), 'الْإِمَامُ' (The Imam). I will select 'الْغَنِيمَةُ', 'الْخُمُسُ', 'الْإِمَامُ'. I will also add 'الْإِذْنُ' (Permission). That's 4 terms. Good.)
